title: Greenbrix C2: Five payments into one
topic: Debt consolidation; private second mortgages: Five payments into one
hook: $2,610 a month in debt payments. Then $1,049.
logline: Seven-slide Greenbrix Capital carousel for Krystian Catala: Five payments into one.
structure: 7 slides: stub-pile cover with $2,610 struck in lime and a green $1,049 slip crossing the edge, four stubs, $2,610 hero with tape, one green slip, about $1,560 freed with before/after stacked bars, 'The debt is still there' with 12 months as a brick wall, CTA with Krystian.
device: the bill pile: every debt is a perforated payment stub; an adding-machine tape runs the math and crosses the seam from slide 3 to 4 (1,350+400+560+300=2,610, then 105,000 x 11.99% / 12 = 1,049.13)
lessons: Title says 'Five payments' but the plan lists four debts; slides say four. Client must confirm four or supply the fifth.
build.mjs throws if the checked math drifts.
